subject: Simple class condition
notes: kb/Work PB64 T5 (2026-08-19): a class condition whose alphabet-name-1 names an ALPHABET … IS LOCALE [locale-name] — of EITHER class (alphanumeric, or FOR NATIONAL) — is COBOL1669 locale-alphabet-not-a-charset: a LOCALE alphabet defines a collating sequence only (§12.3.7.4 GR7, Table 6), so it names no coded character set a class condition could test membership of. DataBinder.IsLocaleAlphabet is the ONE predicate; the same rule family (§12.3.7.3 SR16g / SR17d — the IN phrases of SYMBOLIC CHARACTERS and CLASS; §13.18.13.3 SR1/SR2 — CODE-SET) awaits those phrases binding at all (kb/Work PB110). Rule --check verified at 8.8.4.4.3 2).
